evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep: 'Thank you [Itafe]. Well the main reason of this call is because we received your request...' Uses name once in opening.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep: 'I'm gonna ask you a few questions regarding this move so we can give you an estimate and this would take about ten to fifteen minutes. So, is this a good time to talk about your move?' — framing present but no dependable quote promise.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing after the quid pro quo.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: Rep: 'Normally for an apartment your size we see 25 to 35 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' — opens with logistics, not concerns.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Box count asked: 'Normally for an apartment your size we see 25 to 35 boxes.' Packing not asked.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep: 'We charge an hourly rate which is $220 for two movers already. And everything is included to that gas and truck taxes, insurance, all the wraps and pads... No hidden fees of any type.' — pricing contrast present (all-inclusive vs. add-ons implied), no-notes line absent, fee transparency present. Two of three.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep: 'For a two bedroom apartment, we finishes at five and a half hours. So, in your case... I will only estimate your move to be four and a half to five and a half hours just to give us a range. So the estimated cost is $919 to $1,210.' — personalized to customer's specific conditions (4th floor, fewer boxes, 2-story house).
evidence_quotes.value_days: Never mentioned. No discussion of date flexibility or cheaper alternatives to Friday.
evidence_quotes.prep_and_temperature_check: Prep framing and temperature check never delivered.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Never asked. Rep transitions to deposit/booking without checking for remaining concerns.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep: 'Would you like to be on the schedule for Friday? We do not require any deposit.' — rate lock (implied by estimate) and no-deposit mentioned, but followed by immediate softening: 'I can send everything to you via email... if ever that you have decided that you want to book with us, you could just reply to that email or give us a callback.' This is a built-in out.

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floor access, furniture inventory, special items like 65-inch TVs, pickup and dropoff addresses) and personalized the estimate to the customer's specific move profile (4th-floor with elevator, fewer boxes than typical).
coaching_note: Before moving into logistics probing, ask the two-concerns question ('most of them have one of two concerns: either the movers not showing up on time, or damage to their items. Are either of those a concern for you?') to uncover what matters most to this customer, then deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) to address those concerns directly.
